description: Starfighter on a pole in open ground beside the D400 at Yenigöl Mahallesi, Muratpaşa. Construction number 683D-6070. The International F-104 Society records a light grey F-16 style camouflage applied in 2008. Confirmed present on Esri World Imagery examined September 2026, which resolves the white airframe and its accompanying obelisk. Also present in OpenStreetMap as a memorial=aircraft node named F-104.
